name: truthstone
description: Truthstone (previously named AgentGuard): a deterministic reliability layer for coding agents.

plugins.name: truthstone
plugins.description: Checks what a request takes for granted, sends irreversible or destructive commands to you for sign-off, and holds a "done" that the recorded test evidence contradicts, for Claude Code. Installs its local runtime with uv on first use.

plugins.name: truthstone-practices
plugins.description: Six instruction-only skills: evidence before done, ground claims, scope discipline, proportional planning, safe shell, diff review.
